_metadata.description: Fleet-wide business-contract visibility and deterministic remediation on the shared autofix registry.

requirements.title: Compute-on-read fleet sweep
requirements.description: business-health fleet sweeps scenarios/* on read with as-of stamps (test-genie fleet-status honesty rules): per-scenario contract rollup, starter-registry and template-version laggards, unproven-claim counts, worst-first ranking, bounded time on the real repo.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/fleet/fleet_test.go. Fixture fleet; ranking and stamp assertions; bounded-time smoke against the live repo in phase logs.

requirements.title: Deterministic fixers for every auto-classed finding
requirements.description: Every maturity.json mapping declared fix_class auto has an implemented fixer on the shared maturity-go autofix registry: scaffold missing template sections (TODO-marked), create missing requirements/index.json, normalize OT ID format + status vocabulary, add prd_ref stubs for orphaned OTs.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/autofix/fixers_test.go. Before/after goldens per fixer.

requirements.title: Preview/apply semantics and idempotency
requirements.description: PreviewFix returns diffs without writing; ApplyFix writes only on explicit apply; applying any fixer twice is a no-op; fix --apply then validate shows the target finding resolved.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/autofix/idempotency_test.go. Idempotency + preview-no-write assertions; fix-then-validate integration fixture.

requirements.title: Honest fixer accounting in maturity.json
requirements.description: fixer_status flips pending → implemented only when the fixer ships with tests; findings requiring judgment stay fix_class manual with a written reason — never reclassified to dodge a gap.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/assessment/spec_test.go. Spec load + cross-check: every auto mapping has a registered fixer.

requirements.title: Template-version awareness ratchet
requirements.description: Fleet and per-scenario validation flag scenarios whose generation.template.version predates the current template contract version, so business-contract expectations ratchet forward with the template.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/fleet/template_version_test.go. Laggard detection against fixture service.json stamps.
